principle: No missing uncertainty, geometry, independent cluster, or checksum is inferred or manufactured.

tdip.public_search_result: primary package supports contract and coverage candidate; CRPS power remains unresolved
tdip.evidence: Reykjanes DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15488867 (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15488866) contains 371 acquisition-date observations, of which 370 have paired normal/reciprocal files. Excluding exposed 2022-10-23 leaves 369 formal-eligible paired date observations; unpaired 2023-07-05 is excluded. The frozen observation split is train=79, buffer=17, calibration=50, test=223. Training-only parsing validates ABMN, potential/current, delay and 20 decay windows; robust N/R discrepancies support a heteroscedastic heavy-tailed error model and estimate a 17-day temporal correlation length. Power therefore uses non-overlapping 17-day blocks, not dates: the sealed test has far fewer than 223 effective clusters. Correlated dates, N/R files and windows cannot be replicated into clusters. Paired-CRPS power also cannot be established without two training inference methods.
minimum_external_input: at least 223 genuinely independent acquisition-date/site clusters
ABMN coordinates and timing-window definitions
measured or processing-derived uncertainty with documented method
untouched station/date members for a buffered formal test
tdip.possible_unblocker: run both frozen inference methods on training dates to estimate paired-CRPS effect; keep calibration/test sealed

tem.public_search_result: outcome-blind USGS WalkTEM consortium candidate exists
tem.evidence: Metadata identifies Genesee Valley DOI 10.5066/P9VQOCRZ (120 locations), Mississippi Alluvial Plain DOI 10.5066/P965NBFT (two dense surveys and six transects), Manistee (49 raw USF), Shelter Island DOI 10.5066/P93X25UF (26 soundings), Dawson County DS581, Los Humeros DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3822280 and Illinois River Basin. Observation values remain unopened. Sounding totals are not independent clusters until stations, overlap and spatial correlation are resolved under a frozen common contract.
minimum_external_input: frozen consortium membership/license and common observation contract
outcome-blind unique-station deduplication
spatial correlation length and buffered cross-survey split
tem.possible_unblocker: complete metadata-only station inventory and freeze the split before endpoint access

sip_fdip.evidence: authoritative candidates are laboratory columns/specimens or two field profiles and do not establish 223 independent field clusters. Additional searches found only six clay types (Zenodo 6754562), one illite freeze-thaw study (14016513), two restricted sand-column cases/five channels (17165457), five Dryad rock specimens (10.5061/dryad.pt2624c), and 28 Moffat Shale specimens (GFZ 10.5880/fidgeo.2022.034). SIP-Archiv is a registered petrophysical material database, not a direct spatial field-cluster source.
minimum_external_input: 223 independent specimens, stations, or profiles justified as inference units
frequency, real/imaginary response and full uncertainty/covariance
unambiguous specimen/profile/station keys and geometry
sip_fdip.possible_unblocker: multi-laboratory consortium export with common calibration and replicate-level covariance

csamt.public_search_result: large station pool found but provider granularity and source contract remain disqualifying
csamt.evidence: A CC0 USGS GGT-30 transmitter + GDP32-II receiver consortium is frozen: Big Chino DOI 10.5066/P9KGKWNL (21 lines, 1159 unique station coordinates), Hualapai DOI 10.5066/P90KAJM4 (9 lines, 543), and Red Knoll DOI 10.5066/P9QF9PFR (2 lines, 141). Official station ZIPs prove 1843 coordinate-unique observations with zero exact cross-release duplicates. An outcome-blind 250 m candidate-cell split has 422 test cells, but this is not a correlation-adjusted cluster count. Central-directory-only inspection proves that available raw observations are packaged as one member per full survey line; all 32 station lines mix multiple candidate partitions. Opening training line members would therefore also open calibration/test observations. A line-level sealed split has an absolute upper bound of only 32 lines, below 223. Red Knoll's advertised raw ZIP currently returns HTTP 404. Reports document a 1 km source dipole and source-receiver distance ranges, but not per-acquisition transmitter endpoint coordinates. No formal gate changes.
minimum_external_input: 223 independent receiver/site clusters
finite transmitter endpoints, current and orientation
receiver coordinates, Ex/Hy components, frequencies and phase
source-receiver distance, near/transition/far-field classification and uncertainty
csamt.possible_unblocker: survey-contractor or instrument-vendor raw export plus transmitter GPS logs and processing covariance

wfem.evidence: the only exact geophysical repository result is the already audited Baotu Spring package with 27 lines and no complete source/receiver/phase/component/geometric-factor contract. GFZ/GIPP public metadata does not expose a qualifying large WFEM controlled-source collection. Yemaquan data are available only on reasonable request, Gonghe reports data availability as not applicable, and a 2025 Frontiers case requires an author request. None is a directly downloadable complete field package; paper tables/figures and synthetic libraries are not substitutes for field observations.
minimum_external_input: 223 independent lines or receiver clusters
source endpoints/current/orientation and receiver coordinates
complex electric/magnetic component and phase definitions
apparent-resistivity geometric factor and uncertainty
wfem.possible_unblocker: original acquisition team release of instrument-native files, geometry logs and processing specification

full EMTF residual/inverse-signal covariance export if cross-component covariance is required
